_note: Four optimised inputs, deliberately: every extra axis multiplies the ways to fit noise.
The arming block exists because QSMC_AutoTrader ships inert (InpEnableTrading=false,
InpDryRun=true). In the Strategy Tester those defaults mean zero trades and a flat report.
Keep the arming block in a BACKTEST-ONLY file and never let it reach a live chart.
Every input NOT listed here keeps whatever the EA compiled with - the terminal writes it
into the report so the study records what was actually running.
